page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg7.24xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the Intel Xeon 8369HB processor. Running on the KVM hypervisor, this instance features 96 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core, resulting in 96 vCPUs. The processor operates at a base clock speed of 3.3 GHz, offering consistent compute performance without hyperthreading contention.

The instance is configured with 384.0 GB of RAM, providing a resource density of 4.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached options. The baseline network bandwidth is rated at 32 Gbps, supporting high-throughput data transfers.

The dedicated core allocation and high clock speed offer predictable compute performance, though the lack of local storage and GPU acceleration limits its use for workloads requiring direct-attached NVMe drives or hardware-accelerated parallel processing. This hardware profile is suitable for compute-heavy general-purpose workloads, distributed databases, enterprise applications, and parallel processing tasks that benefit from dedicated physical cores and a balanced memory-to-CPU ratio.
